title: Missed Early-Route Addition — Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
**Specimen Collection Appointments: early-route addition on a missed Mobile In-Home Collection Visit.**

A missed visit that was to start early carries an early-route addition, reckoned on the people booked on the visit — the patient and the additional household members booked on it, as the visit record shows them:

- a missed visit that was to start **before 08:00 on a Saturday or Sunday** is charged the early-route addition per person booked, **10.00 for the patient and 10.00 for each additional household member** booked on the visit;
- one that was to start **before 08:00 on a weekday** is charged it **once per visit, 5.00** whatever the number of people booked;
- one starting **at 08:00 or later** carries no early-route addition.

| Start (appointment start time) | Saturday or Sunday | Weekday |
|---|---|---|
| Before 08:00 | 10.00 multiplied by the people booked | 5.00 once |
| 08:00 or later | None | None |

## Cases (hypothetical missed visits)

| Day | Start | Additional household members booked | Addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sunday | 07:00 | 0 | 10.00 |
| Saturday | 07:00 | 2 | 30.00 (three people) |
| Tuesday | 07:00 | 2 | 5.00 |
| Saturday | 08:00 | 1 | None — 08:00 is not before 08:00 |
